title: Go where ego comes off
summary: This meets the self trying to cleanse itself without surrender. The line says ego actually falls in saintly company.
lifeApplication: When you feel sticky with self-concern, do not stay private. Sit near the one whose presence makes performance unnecessary and let that company do its work.

source.shortMeaning: Saintly company washes off the ego you cannot scrub alone.
source.lifeApplication: When self-concern thickens, move toward the company that makes performance unnecessary.

evidence.coreClaim: Saintly company washes off the ego you cannot scrub alone.
evidence.turn: Seek the company that washes the heart and turns it toward Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel sticky with self-concern, do not stay private. Sit near the one whose presence makes performance unnecessary and let that company do its work.
